contributions.detail: 15 typed Form A rows sum to exactly 12,300.00, which equals BOTH Form A's printed footer TOTAL ('12,300') and the cover line-1 THIS REPORT cell ('12300'). It does NOT equal the cumulative cell (42,028.39), so this schedule is genuinely PER-PERIOD (6/29/2018-10/30/2018). That is a DIFFERENT SCOPE from the CUMULATIVE column this module publishes as the filing's figure - reconciles_* should be left blank rather than treated as a failure. Cover arithmetic independently closes: 29,728.39 + 12,300 = 42,028.39. Line 2 (the $50.00-or-less aggregate) was left blank in all three columns, so no sub-$50 aggregate is in play and cover line 1 is the only correct anchor. NB one itemized row (Brent Hall, 50.00) is at/below the $50 itemisation threshold; the filer itemised it anyway and it IS inside the printed 12,300 total - kept verbatim.

expenditures.detail: 8 typed Form B rows sum to exactly 5,920.21, equal to Form B's printed footer TOTAL and to the cover line-3 THIS REPORT cell; the cumulative cell is 33,156.67, so per-period. Cover arithmetic closes: 27,236.46 + 5,920.21 = 33,156.67.

notes: PRIVACY: this cover prints the candidate's home street address, home phone and ZIP in the clear and Form A's third column is a full street-address column - all of it discarded at read time. Only city names actually written in that column are kept; where the filer wrote street + ZIP with no city (11 of 15 rows) donor_city is honestly BLANK - a ZIP is never resolved to a city. No state was printed for any donor, so donor_state is blank throughout. LABEL vs FORM: the chunk file's office is 'Commission Seat A'; the form's Office line reads only 'Washington County Commissioner' with no seat letter, and the Representative District and School District lines are blank - not a contradiction, just less specific. Candidate name matches ('Gilbert Michael Almquist'). Reporting period 6/29/2018-10/30/2018, dated and clerk-stamped RECEIVED OCT 30 2018 (the chunk filename says 10-31-2018). Two rows name the same organisation with a spelling difference the filer made ('Wash Co Board of Realtors' 6/19 vs 'Wash Co Board of Relators' 9/18) - both kept verbatim. Row 10's amount is typed with a stray leading comma ('$ , 500.00'); it is 500.00 and the schedule total proves it. PDF stores Page rot 270; all pct: geometry is in the portrait frame poppler renders.
